claims.statement: The prior slot correction mitigation failed because it was applied to the wrong carrier feed; the specific carrier feed(s) serving the 186 orders had not been identified.
claims.corroboration: Tier-1 observability outcome explicitly states correction was applied to wrong feed.
claims.limitation: The evidence identifies the failure but not which feed is correct; requires follow-up diagnostic.

claims.statement: The 186 orders in EXC-0921 are bound for one or more specific carrier feeds at the east node; the 47-minute confirmation lag is specific to one or more of these feeds.
claims.corroboration: m8_r_handoffs identified the 47-minute lag for east-node orders in EXC-0921; but multiple carriers may serve the east-node dock.
claims.limitation: The specific carrier feed(s) have not yet been identified; multiple carriers may be involved.

next_action.rationale: The prior mitigation failed because it was applied to the wrong carrier feed. Carrier Operations must identify which specific carrier feed(s) the 186 EXC-0921 orders are bound for and confirm which one(s) have the 47-minute confirmation lag. Once the feed(s) are identified by name/id, apply_slot_correction can be re-run on the correct feed only.
next_action.expected_information_gain: Identification of the specific carrier feed(s) responsible for the 47-minute lag and the correct scope for the next mitigation attempt.
